pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with smooth to moderate pixel gradients at the boundaries; patches exhibit varied spatial area, with elongation occurring along the vertical axis of the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected topological graph of light-colored pelage; junction nodes are primarily tri-radial; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior margin of the neck mane, transitioning to a smoother profile toward the shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Prominent localized region of dark hyper-pigmented and matted hair located on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant visual occlusion of the primary subject's posterior region by the head and neck of a secondary individual in the right-center foreground.
